purpose: Recover the GOES M/X events that SWAN-SF V2 attached to no HARP through an independent association (NOAA SGAS region number joined to the definitive JSOC NOAA_ARS keyword), rebuild the development table with the recovered labels from the verified V2 archives, and rerun the frozen walk-forward recipes on the relabelled table. Development evidence only: no model promotion, no dashboard threshold change, no reserved test access.
why: The label coverage audit (docs/label-coverage-20261110.md) found that only 29.6% (2022) and 28.9% (2023) of the NOAA_ARS-mapped SGAS M/X events reach a positive label, against 87-95% in 2014-2017, because V2 attached 174 and 293 M/X events of those years to no HARP and the fail-closed rule excludes the windows that contain them. Flaring HARPs therefore keep only negative windows in both training and evaluation, and such HARPs produce 38.6% and 57.2% of the watch-tier false alarms.

association.scope: Only the M/X events of the frozen HEK inventory that V2 attached to no HARP. Events V2 attached with an accepted confidence keep V2's HARP; the independent association never overrides V2.
association.sgas_match: A HEK unassigned event matches the SGAS section-A rows with the same GOES class whose peak time differs by at most 5 minutes. The matched rows' region numbers (4-digit numbers below 5000 are raised by 10000) are the candidate NOAA regions.
association.harp_lookup: Each candidate region is looked up in NOAA_ARS on the SGAS peak date (data/harp_noaa_mapping_20261109_r1). The event's candidate HARPs are the union over its candidate regions.

outcomes.recovered: Exactly one candidate HARP: the event is attached to it at the HEK peak time.
outcomes.ambiguous: More than one candidate HARP: fail closed; windows of every candidate HARP that contain the peak are excluded as excluded_ambiguous_harp unless they are positive for another reason.
outcomes.unmapped: Candidate regions exist but none maps to a HARP on that date: the event stays unassigned.
outcomes.no_region: The SGAS rows carry no region number: the event stays unassigned.
outcomes.no_sgas_match: No SGAS row matches: the event stays unassigned.

labels.rule: Apply the frozen V2 contract (helio24.v2_contract.label_windows) with the unassigned inventory reduced to the events that stay unassigned, then mark every window of a recovered HARP with forecast_time <= peak < prediction_end as positive and every such window of an ambiguous event's candidate HARPs as excluded_ambiguous_harp. Precedence: positive, excluded_ambiguous_harp, excluded_unassigned_major_event, negative, as in the frozen contract.
labels.kept_columns: The frozen development schema plus label_status_v2, the status of the window under the frozen contract, kept for the consistency check and the transition counts.
labels.consistency: Every window of the frozen shards must appear in the relabelled table with identical features and its frozen label_status equal to label_status_v2; every window absent from the frozen shards must have an excluded label_status_v2. The materialisation fails otherwise.

materialisation.source: The four verified SWAN-SF V2 archives streamed again through helio24.v2_archive (about 5.0 GB, checked against the frozen manifest hashes). Roles, stride, cadence and leap-second rules are those of config/experiment5-v5.json and helio24.v2_features.

walk_forward.folds: helio24.walk_forward.annual_fold on the relabelled table for every year of config/walk-forward-v1.json (2014-2023); years whose training or calibration role lacks both classes are skipped as in the frozen run.

arms.frozen_models_old_labels: The frozen walk-forward ensemble scored on the frozen labels (artifacts/temporal_years_20261101_r1, column baseline). Reference, copied not recomputed.
arms.frozen_models_new_labels: The frozen per-year models and calibrators (artifacts/walk_forward_20261028_r1/<year>/models.joblib) applied to the relabelled evaluation windows with their frozen thresholds: the label effect alone.
arms.relabelled_models: The config/walk-forward-v1.json recipes (0.45 logistic + 0.55 XGBoost, sigmoid calibration) refitted on the relabelled expanding training role, calibrated on the relabelled previous year: label and model effect together.

operating_points.recall_0.95: The frozen walk-forward rule: previous-year calibration threshold at window recall 0.95 (frozen value for the frozen models, recomputed on the relabelled calibration year for the relabelled models).
operating_points.recall_0.90: The operating-point-v2 watch rule: previous-year calibration threshold at window recall 0.90 (artifacts/operating_point_review_20261109_r1/deployable_thresholds.json for the frozen models, recomputed for the relabelled models).

walk_forward.metrics: Per year, arm and operating point: windows, positives, tp, fp, fn, tn, precision, recall, accuracy, always-negative accuracy, average precision, and 95% HARP-cluster bootstrap intervals (1000 draws, seed 24) for precision and recall.

reading.R1_labels_explain_cycle25: In both 2022 and 2023 the relabelled_models precision at recall_0.90 exceeds the frozen_models_old_labels precision and its bootstrap lower bound lies above that frozen value: the missing labels were a main cause of the cycle-25 weakness.
reading.R2_accuracy_goal: Reported as a count: evaluation years with positives in which the relabelled_models accuracy at recall_0.90 is at least the always-negative accuracy, against the same count for frozen_models_old_labels. Precision above 0.50 is equivalent.
reading.R3_label_versus_model: Reported, not judged: whether frozen_models_new_labels or relabelled_models has the higher precision at recall_0.90 in 2022 and 2023, separating the label effect from the refit.
reading.R4_no_gain: The condition of R1 fails in 2022 or 2023: the recovered labels do not explain the weakness; reported as is.

scope: Development years only; the reserved 2024-2025 test is not read. SGAS region numbers and NOAA_ARS are associations made by NOAA and JSOC, not ground truth; disagreement with V2 is not measured here because V2 attached these events to no HARP. The relabelled table is development evidence: adopting it for the production model, the operating point or the dashboard is a separate decision.
prohibitions: No model promotion or dashboard threshold change
No new readings after seeing results
No overwrite of the frozen shards or frozen experiments
